zh.title: 星宇布拉格直飛載客率逾8成 10月起增為每週4班
zh.summary: 星宇航空布拉格航線8月開航載客率約82%；10月起增為每週4班，淡季維持8成以上
body: 星宇航空今年首度進軍歐洲，8月開航臺北－布拉格直飛航線，10月起增為每週4班。中央社報導指出，星宇航空與先前已開航的華航，形成10月起臺捷兩地「天天有航班」的直飛網絡。
星宇航空公關長梁文龍表示，布拉格航線自8月1日開航後，單月載客率82%，之後10月起增班為4班，進入歐洲淡季的11月仍維持8成以上的載客率。他指出，旺季來自臺灣旅客前往布拉格，淡季受惠捷克赴臺灣並轉機日本的挹注。
星宇航空表示，布拉格航線除拓展雙邊觀光旅客商機，也有助串聯雙邊企業投資及半導體供應鏈交流。梁文龍看好布拉格直飛效益，能串起臺灣與捷克在觀光以及企業投資、半導體供應鏈的合作。
根據捷克觀光局資料顯示，2025年1至8月臺灣旅客到訪捷克人數為10.27萬人，今年已成長至10.88萬人次，年增5.9%。今年8月臺灣旅客到訪捷克的人數為1.59萬人次，比去年8月1.31萬人次，年增21.07%。
在產業面，隨著臺積電在德國德勒斯登（Dresden）設廠，進一步帶動臺灣供應鏈業者赴其鄰國捷克佈局。臺灣高美可科技已計劃在位於德捷邊境的捷克烏斯季州（Ústí nad Labem）投資建廠，從事半導體零件組清洗與表面處理業務。
星宇航空也邀請歌手蔡依林擔任布拉格航線大使，由蔡依林以單曲製作人身分操刀，將代表作「布拉格廣場」重新詮釋。
此外，星宇航空攜手日本藝術家空山基（Hajime Sorayama）將兩架新世代Airbus A350-1000塗裝為「空山金」與「空山銀」藝術機，已於7月起投入日本東京、美國鳳凰城航線，並於9月1日起執飛布拉格航線，自10月1日起AIRSORAYAMA主題航班啟航。梁文龍受訪表示，目前東京航線早班載客率大約9成左右，鳳凰城也維持高載客率。

en.title: STARLUX Taipei–Prague direct service load factor above 80%; four weekly flights from October
en.summary: STARLUX says Prague route load factor was about 82% after August launch; October frequency rose to four weekly flights
body: STARLUX Airlines launched a direct Taipei–Prague route in August, its first move into Europe this year, and increased the service to four weekly flights from October, CNA reported. Together with China Airlines' earlier Prague service, the two carriers form a direct network giving Taiwan and the Czech Republic daily flights from October.

STARLUX public relations chief Liang Wen-lung said the Prague route recorded a monthly load factor of 82% after its 1 August launch, and that after the October increase to four weekly flights, the load factor stayed above 80% even as Europe entered the low season in November. He said peak-season traffic comes from Taiwanese travellers heading to Prague, while the low season benefits from Czech passengers travelling to Taiwan and connecting onward to Japan.

According to STARLUX, the Prague route expands tourism business between the two sides and also helps link bilateral corporate investment and semiconductor supply chain exchanges. Liang said he sees the direct-flight effect connecting Taiwan and the Czech Republic in tourism as well as corporate investment and semiconductor supply chain cooperation.

Citing Czech Tourist Authority data, the report said 102,700 Taiwanese visitors travelled to the Czech Republic in January to August 2025, rising to 108,800 this year, an increase of 5.9% year on year. In August this year, 15,900 Taiwanese visitors arrived in the Czech Republic, compared with 13,100 in August last year, up 21.07%.

On the industrial side, TSMC's plant in Dresden, Germany, has encouraged Taiwanese supply chain companies to expand into neighbouring Czech Republic. Taiwan's Komico Technology plans to invest in a plant in the Ústí nad Labem region on the Czech-German border, engaged in cleaning and surface treatment of semiconductor components.
STARLUX has also invited singer Jolin Tsai to serve as ambassador for the Prague route, reinterpreting her hit song "Prague Square" as producer of the single.

STARLUX also worked with Japanese artist Hajime Sorayama to paint two next-generation Airbus A350-1000 aircraft as the "Sorayama Gold" and "Sorayama Silver" art jets. They entered service on Tokyo and Phoenix routes from July, began flying the Prague route on 1 September, and AIRSORAYAMA-themed flights started on 1 October. Liang said the Tokyo morning service currently runs at a load factor of about 90%, and Phoenix also maintains a high load factor.

zh.title: 美國航空客艙霧氣迫使緊急降落 乘客撤離至跑道
zh.summary: 美國航空客艙出現霧氣後緊急降落，乘客撤離至跑道。
body: Simple Flying標題稱，美國航空乘客在客艙霧氣迫使飛機緊急降落後，撤離至跑道。標題將客艙霧氣與緊急降落相連，並指出乘客撤離的位置是跑道；其描述的事件包括客艙霧氣、緊急降落及跑道撤離。
Simple Flying摘要另稱，起飛後不久氧氣面罩展開，部分乘客從機翼跳下。摘要將氧氣面罩展開的時間描述為起飛後不久，並限定為部分乘客從機翼跳下；這些是摘要提到的另外兩項事件細節。

en.title: American Airlines Passengers Evacuate Onto Runway After Cabin Haze Forces Emergency Landing
en.summary: American Airlines passengers evacuate after cabin haze forces an emergency landing.
body: Simple Flying's headline says American Airlines passengers evacuated onto a runway after cabin haze forced an emergency landing. It presents the haze as forcing the landing and identifies the runway as the place where passengers evacuated. The headline's account therefore describes cabin haze, an emergency landing and a runway evacuation.

The report's summary adds that oxygen masks deployed shortly after takeoff and that some passengers jumped from the wing. It specifies that some passengers jumped, and places the mask deployment shortly after takeoff. These are the additional details provided in the summary alongside the headline's account of the landing and runway evacuation.

zh.title: 巴基斯坦延長印度航空器領空禁令至11月24日
zh.summary: 巴基斯坦延長對印度航空器的領空禁令，期限至2026年11月24日。
body: 巴基斯坦已將對印度航空器的領空禁令延長一個月，限制措施將維持至2026年11月24日。Pakistan Airports Authority（PAA）發布新的航行通告（NOTAM），將限制期延至原定2026年10月24日到期日之後。
禁令適用於印度註冊航空器，以及由印度航空公司或營運商擁有、營運或租賃的航空器，包括軍用航班；管制範圍涵蓋巴基斯坦卡拉奇與拉合爾飛航情報區。航班視目的地改道繞飛巴基斯坦，常經阿拉伯海及伊朗領空；較長航程會增加燃油消耗與營運成本。

en.title: Pakistan extends airspace ban on Indian aircraft through November 24
en.summary: Pakistan extends its airspace ban on Indian aircraft through November 24, 2026.
body: Pakistan has extended its airspace ban on Indian aircraft for another month, with restrictions set to remain in place until November 24, 2026. Pakistan Airports Authority issued a new Notice to Airmen (NOTAM), extending the restriction beyond its previous expiry date of October 24, 2026.

The ban applies to Indian-registered aircraft and aircraft owned, operated or leased by Indian airlines and operators, including military flights. It covers the Karachi and Lahore flight information regions. Depending on their destination, flights take longer routes around Pakistan, often via the Arabian Sea and Iranian airspace; the longer routes increase fuel burn and operating costs.
